The reported NAV is ex-dividend a special dividend of 0.75 pence per Ordinary share which will be paid on 30 September 2026 to those shareholders on the Company’s register on 21 August 2026. The unaudited cum-dividend NAV was 32.59 pence per Ordinary share.
